title: Count the even numbers
prompt: Write a function named count_evens that takes one argument, numbers, a list of whole numbers, and returns how many of them are even. Zero counts as even. If the list is empty the answer is 0. Return the count, do not print it.

title: Sum up to a number
prompt: Write a function named sum_to that takes one whole number, n, and returns the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 up to and including n. For example sum_to(5) returns 15 because 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 is 15. If n is less than 1 the answer is 0. Return the total, do not print it.

title: Count the vowels
prompt: Write a function named count_vowels that takes one string, word, and returns how many of its characters are lower case vowels. The vowels are a, e, i, o and u. Upper case letters do not count. An empty string has 0 vowels. Return the count, do not print it.

title: Largest number in a list
prompt: Write a function named find_max that takes one argument, numbers, a list holding at least one number, and returns the largest number in it. Work it out with a loop rather than relying on a built in shortcut. Return the number, do not print it.

title: Letter grade
prompt: Write a function named letter_grade that takes one number, score, and returns the matching letter grade as a string. A score of 90 or more is "A", 80 or more is "B", 70 or more is "C", 60 or more is "D", and anything below 60 is "F". Return the letter, do not print it.
